source.stem:
The least value of $\alpha \in \mathbb{R}$ for which $4 \alpha x^{2}+\frac{1}{x} \geq 1$, for all $x>0$, is

(A) $\frac{1}{64}$

(B) $\frac{1}{32}$

(C) $\frac{1}{27}$

(D) $\frac{1}{25}$

intelligence.enrichment: If a fountain fills one cistern in t days, then in one day it fills 1 ÷ t cisterns; combined one-day filling rates add, and the time for one full cistern is the reciprocal of the combined rate.
